nodes.rationale: No compiled binary exists; the application is a directly-interpreted PHP script, so no build/compile step is required before running the embedded PHP server.

nodes.label: Category Theory Architecture
nodes.rationale: Applied to ensure data integrity and provide clear, type-safe error handling through a categorical pipeline, rather than ad-hoc validation logic.

nodes.label: Free Category Inductor F(G) (Prof. Irus Grinis Model)
nodes.norm_label: free category inductor f(g) (prof. irus grinis model)
nodes.rationale: Vertices are travel states and morphisms are composable directed-travel-edge paths, ensuring an itinerary is always a connected, valid walk through the travel graph.

nodes.label: Functors (RouteList)
nodes.rationale: Maps functions over collections of travel options so discounts can be applied to all providers simultaneously.

nodes.label: Monads (Option / Either)
nodes.rationale: Option handles missing values (no flights/hotels); Either carries success/failure with error context. Used in a Kleisli pipeline to short-circuit invalid graph edges during itinerary building.

nodes.label: Monoids (TripMetrics)
nodes.rationale: Combines costs, durations and points associatively to aggregate activity costs and evaluate the strict monoidal functor over the induced graph path.

nodes.label: Natural Transformations (RouteList::headOption())
nodes.rationale: Converts a list of options to the best single option, used to select the cheapest flight/hotel from available choices.

nodes.label: Graceful Degradation via Option/Either when remote APIs are unreachable

nodes.rationale: If Open-Meteo and Frankfurter/ECB are both unreachable, the app degrades the flow via the Option/Either monad instead of failing silently, showing a controlled error to the user.

Three new assertions reproducing Prof. Grinis' exact counter-examples bring it to 18/18 laws verified.

nodes.label: Itinerary::advance
nodes.rationale: Original code computed FreeCategoryPath::compose correctly but discarded a Left (non-composable edge) result, letting an invalid itinerary succeed with the stale previous path. Fixed to throw a RuntimeException carrying the categorical Left error message when compose returns Left, propagating the composition failure instead of swallowing it.
nodes.source_location: Sec. 2.3, Listing 6-7, p.10; Appendix A, Listing 14, p.20

nodes.label: Option::pure
nodes.rationale: Original implementation treated false as equivalent to null (absence), so Some(false) >>= pure produced None instead of Some(false), violating the monad right-identity law. Fixed so only null denotes absence: '($value === null) ? new None() : new Some($value)'.

nodes.label: Some::fmap
nodes.rationale: Shares the Option::pure root cause though not reported by Prof. Grinis: before the fix, mapping a function returning false over a Some value silently produced None instead of Some(false). The single-line fix to Option::pure repaired Some::fmap automatically since it is defined in terms of pure.

nodes.label: TripMetrics::append
nodes.rationale: Original version rounded costEur to two decimals after every addition, making (a⊕b)⊕c != a⊕(b⊕c) for a=0.004,b=0.004,c=0.005 (0.02 vs 0.01). Fixed by rounding to whole cents exactly once at construction (costCents) and adding integers, which is associative over Z.

nodes.label: Property-Based Law Testing (Future Work)
nodes.rationale: Generating random floats, booleans and graph shapes and checking each law automatically would very likely have caught Option::pure(false) and the sub-cent monoid rounding without waiting for a human reviewer.

nodes.label: fetchLiveJsonOption
nodes.rationale: The one caller that relied on Option::pure's old false-as-absence behaviour (file_get_contents returns false sentinel on failure). Since pure no longer treats false as absence, this call site was changed to test the sentinel explicitly ('if ($raw === false) return new None();') instead of overloading pure with two meanings. Verified live against Open-Meteo and Frankfurter/ECB.
